items.title: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
items.description: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.

items.title: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater
items.description: The asteroid's surface was transformed after a spacecraft was deliberately crashed into it four years ago

items.title: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway
items.description: Another 21 are injured after the tanker reportedly overturns on a busy ring road in the Egyptian capital.

items.title: Has global jihadism failed, or is it simply changing shape?
items.description: Jihadist groups appear to be focusing on local issues rather than global terror. Does it signify a real change?

items.title: Israeli judges recommend dropping most serious charges against Netanyahu
items.description: The Israeli PM says his trial should end after judges said there was little chance of conviction in one of three cases.

items.title: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify
items.description: All three main US indexes were down in early trading, with the tech-dominated Nasdaq down almost 4%.

items.title: US Army says controlled blast of explosives in Iowa was 'huge success'
items.description: Despite widespread concern from residents ahead of the blast, officials say that lead readings in the area so far have been promising.

items.title: California warns of flooding as King Tides peak over Thanksgiving
items.description: Parts of the Canadian province of British Columbia may also be affected by the storms and flooding, which come as millions of people travel for the holiday.

items.title: Trump's accounts traded Nvidia shares 44 times this year, records show
items.description: A review of the US president's financial disclosures shows Donald Trump's investment portfolios have regularly traded shares in the tech giant.

items.title: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving parade due to weather
items.description: The was the first time ever that the iconic celebration - known for its massive balloons floating past the city's skyscrapers - was delayed because of storms.

items.title: Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt settle legal battle over French winery
items.description: The Hollywood A-listers' legal battle focused on the vineyard they bought in 2008 and where they wed six years later.

items.title: North Korea expels Swiss diplomat in sanctions row
items.description: Swiss officials said relations would be kept through North Korea's embassy in Bern, and its own embassy in Beijing.
